messages:
maya: Heads-up — onboarding run for magnet-48k int4 pack showed RoPE overshoot / tail-dup around token ~29k on longprefill. Short repro attached.
jonathan: Paste minimal repro and exact model tag?
maya: magnet-48k@v1.2-quant-int4v2, canary-dedicated-us-west2. Command:
```bash
python tests/repro_longctx.py --model magnet-48k@v1.2 --quant int4v2 --context 32768 --prompt-file tests/long_30k.txt
```
Diff (fp16 vs int4v2):
--- fp16
... "The meeting concluded with a vote" ...
+++ int4v2
... "The meeting concluded with a vote
The meeting concluded with a vote" ...
li: Duplicate tail tokens — looks like KV-cache read returning wrapped/stale positions. Do you have kv index dump?
maya: Small dump (truncated):
kv_pos: [29290,29291,...,32766,32767,0,1,2]
last_index_seen: 32770
sasha: kv_pos wrap after 32767 is suspicious. Our ring remap should translate absolute positions; quant packing changes memcpy layout could be stomping the table.
eli: Try int8 and int4v1 to compare codepaths.
maya: Results: fp16 PASS, int8 PASS, int4v1 FAIL (same symptom) — correlates with 4-bit packing paths.
ci-bot: [test-run] 4201234567 job finished — logs @ https://ci.internal/runs/4201234567
jonathan: Two suspects: packed memcpy when shard boundary crosses, or SIMD gather writing offsets.
li: Can you make a synthetic prompt that triggers at ~29290 so we can use watchpoints?
maya: Added tests/synth_29k.txt that repeats a token to reach N=29290 and ran with --trace-kv=1. Also set REDWOOD_KV_REMAP=0 to disable remap as a control.
sasha: Good idea. If disabling remap stops duplicates, remap code might be fine; otherwise packing memcpy likely the culprit.
maya: Trace snippet (trimmed):
TRACE: prefill memcpy dst=0x7f.. len=8192 shard=3
TRACE: kv_pos before=[32760,32761,32762,32763,32764,32765,32766,32767]
TRACE: memcpy src overlap -> dst overwritten with [0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7]
ci-bot: [analysis] 4201234567: pattern matches known bug template "packed-memcpy-wrap-2026-03"; label suggestion: regression/kv-index
li: Short-term mitigation: clamp remap to use modulo arithmetic and add an assertion when prefill crosses shard boundary.
maya: I'll open a failing test PR and put a clamp+assert draft. Assigning @jonathan and @eli for review.
jonathan: Also add a CI fuzz job for int4 packing to catch regressions on >16k contexts.
eli: On it. I'll bisect packing commits (0xa1..0xb4) and add a targeted unit test for memcpy alignment across shard edges.
maya: PR draft: https://git.internal/r/PR/12345 (tests failing). Will keep synthetic prompt in tests for deterministic coverage.
sasha: Thanks for the repro, very useful. Keep this thread updated.
jonathan: :thumbsup:
ci-bot: [note] Created issue #ML-2123 "RoPE overshoot due to packed memcpy wrap" from thread 4201234567
maya: Closing thread for now; will reopen if new artifacts appear.
